title: Later-Period Home Health Episodes under Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, an episode that follows earlier home care is a later period and is shorter, for authorization types that require the patient to be homebound (the Home Health Care Authorization), when the authorization is issued after reconsideration.

## Evidence on file

Home health visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines, by date of service. "Between one and three months ago" means dated in the last three months but not in the last month; "between three and twelve months ago" means dated in the last twelve months but not in the last three months.

## Clause (types that require the patient to be homebound)

1. Where home health visits of the patient are dated between one and three months ago, **4 visits** are taken off.
2. Where none are, but home health visits are dated between three and twelve months ago, **2 visits** are taken off.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken off.

For a type that does not require the patient to be homebound, nothing is taken off under this rule.

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Home health visits on record | Visits taken off |
|---|---|
| one dated six weeks ago | 4 |
| one dated two weeks ago and one dated seven months ago | 2 |
| one dated five months ago and one dated two months ago | 4 |
| only visits dated in the last month | 0 |
| none in the last twelve months | 0 |
